mapper.sql: WHERE q.bank_id IN #{id}q.bank_id=#{scope.questionBankId} AND q.status='ACTIVE' AND NOT q.is_group AND (q.reading_parent_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question parent WHERE parent.id=q.reading_parent_id AND parent.status='ACTIVE')) AND q.id IN #{id} AND q.chapter_id IN #{id} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_favorite f WHERE f.user_id=#{userId} AND f.question_id=q.id) AND (SELECT i.self_assessmenti.outcome FROM practice_item i JOIN practice_session ps ON ps.id=i.session_id WHERE i.question_id=q.id AND ps.user_id=#{userId} AND ps.status='SUBMITTED' AND i.outcome='SELF_RATED' AND i.self_assessment IS NOT NULLAND i.outcome IN ('CORRECT','WRONG') ORDER BY ps.submitted_at DESC,ps.id DESC LIMIT 1)='WRONG' AND (SELECT count(*) FROM practice_item i JOIN practice_session ps ON ps.id=i.session_id WHERE i.question_id=q.id AND ps.user_id=#{userId} AND ps.status='SUBMITTED' AND i.outcome='WRONG') >= 2 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM practice_item i JOIN practice_session ps ON ps.id=i.session_id WHERE i.question_id=q.id AND ps.user_id=#{userId} AND ps.status='SUBMITTED' AND ps.submitted_at >= now()-interval '7 days' AND i.outcome IN ('CORRECT','WRONG','SELF_RATED')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM practice_item i JOIN practice_session ps ON ps.id=i.session_id WHERE i.question_id=q.id AND ps.user_id=#{userId} AND ps.status='SUBMITTED' AND i.outcome IN ('CORRECT','WRONG','SELF_RATED'))
mapper.select: WITH candidates AS(SELECT q.*,coalesce(q.reading_parent_id,q.id)q.id group_id, coalesce(parent.created_at,q.created_at) group_created, array_position(ARRAY[CAST(#{id} AS uuid)],q.id)0 requested_position FROM question q LEFT JOIN question parent ON parent.id=q.reading_parent_id ), groups AS(SELECT group_id,min(group_created) created_at,min(requested_position) requested_position,count(*) size FROM candidates GROUP BY group_id), ordered AS(SELECT *,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY requested_position,random(),created_at,group_id) position FROM groups), limits AS(SELECT *,sum(size) OVER(ORDER BY position) total FROM ordered) SELECT c.* FROM candidates c JOIN limits g ON g.group_id=c.group_id WHERE g.total <= #{scope.count} ORDER BY g.position,c.reading_order,c.id
